SPECIFICATION FOR 
PICKING NOSE, BOSS AND SHELL FOR LOOMS 



CO 



o 

p. 
E 
o 
O 



1. Scope — Prescribes requirements for picking nose, picking boss, and picking shell for looms. 

2. Manufacture 

2.1 Material — Cast iron or any other suitable material as agreed to between the buyer and the 
seller. 

2.2 Freedom from Defects — Components shall be sound, clean and free from blow holes, hard spots 
and other harmful defects. 

2.3 Provision of Test Bars — The test bars shall be cast separately. They shall be poured at the 
same time and from the same ladle of metal as the components they represent. 

3. Requirements 

3.1 D//nens/oA?s — Shall be as agreed to between the buyer and the seller according to the make of 
loom subject to the tolerances specified in 15:5519-1969 'Deviations for untoleranced dimensions 
of grey iron castings '. 

3.1.1 Typical picking nose, boss and shell are shown in Fig. 1 to 3.

4. Marking — Each component shall be legibly marked with the manufacturer's name or trade- 
mark. 

4-1 ISI ^Certification Marking — The component may also be marked with ISI Certification Mark. 
Details of the scheme are available with the Indian Standards Institution. 

5. Sampling — Unless otherwise agreed to between the buyer and the seller, for inspection of 
dimensions and hardness, the single sampling plan with Inspection Level I anxJ Acceptable Quality 
Level (AQL) of 2'5 percent given m Tables 1 and 2 of IS: 2500 ( Part I )-1973 'Sampling inspection 
tables; Part I Inspection by attributes and by count of defects ( first revision ) ' shall be followed.
